product: Unit FlashLight U152 / UIFlow2 FlashLightUnit / AW3641EDNR
original_question: 需要按AW3641E实际EN单线脉冲协议模拟全部FlashLight档位，并核对UIFlow2原驱动。
feedback: 2026-10-27复查UIFlow2 2.5.3@50e440780492aa847378c7d3477ab912f7063bac与当前master@3a86d8f611b3639cca755a933e01a5a829771ef1 m5stack/libs/unit/flash_light.py，两文件相同SHA25610546386ee156034c268404e96f4d086b88c52254da1fcd2aa19130ce2f6629f。BRIGHTNESS100..30=1..8，TIME220=1/TIME1300=2，flash()用pulse=brightness*time。产品页公开链接AW3641E Feb2019 V1.3 datasheet https://m5stack.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/resource/docs/datasheet/unit/FlashLight/FLASHLEDDRIVER_2019-07-01.PDF（SHA256ff6ee09ea120f612f43c39af6318d98e86a778d9cb3ecf1e643d794a94c52a6e）p13 Table1明确脉冲1..8=100..30%/220ms，9..16=100..30%/1.3s。故flash(BRIGHTNESS_100,TIME_1300MS)实际发2脉冲，对应90%/220ms；flash(BRIGHTNESS_60,TIME_1300MS)发10脉冲，对应90%/1.3s，并非60%/1.3s。仅TIME1300的BRIGHTNESS30碰巧正确。M5Unit-FLASHLIGHT@4071dde9ec5a60cb165628f7830effdf95f8eda1新驱动也注明此1..16表。另flash()每次开始未保证EN低>500us复位（datasheet p13-14），turn_off=False连续调用需要核对。产品页称Torch通过EN PWM无级调光，但datasheet p14的PWM调光在FLASH管脚，20-50kHz且EN先高/FLASH先低>2ms；U152原理图FLASH只接板内S1，而Grove仅暴露EN。需明确EN门控PWM与芯片FLASH混合模式PWM的区别。以上为源代码/公开资料复查，未做硬件测量。
expected_information: 修正或解释1300ms脉冲编码（按表应为brightness+8）和连续调用复位；更新复制残留的adc/pump端口描述；提供GPIO与原驱动实际波形/示例，澄清U152可从Grove实现的Torch PWM能力。
